messages.quote: 反正剛剛範圍的審查我都已經通過了，如果這次S05搞定的話，就快點明確開始S06的動作的前準備，要PR的PR，要 merge 的 merge，它不能 merge就你來 merge。
搞完就開始S06，不要停下來了，拜託。

conditionSatisfied: S05 bounded acceptance/completion recorded in B2 and PR6 merged; main/work actual remote readback M2. Original maintainer must verify fetched ancestry/content and safely synchronize local work before activation.
scope: S06 complete workspace and editing interaction under frozenS06/accepted contracts and current Owner Legacy UI/UX/icon, coherent controls/shortcuts, Pixel/Vertex Stage entry and usable-testing requirements. Sequence bounded engineering deliveries with exact scope and evidence; do not impose generic Human testing stops after each internal batch.
acceptanceFamilies: AT-S06-03 only after G-PD-2 branch is resolved and included
AT-S06-04 only actually qualified browser/device/interaction branches
exclusions: No automatic all catalog/391 shader-node expansion
No arbitrary external Panel extension claim
No unaccepted optional legacy proposal promoted by reference
No silent named-preset retention policy choice
prerequisites: S05 merged bounded delivery and preserved accepted evidence
Same original writer; preserved deferred Escape work explicitly reconciled
applicableGateBranches: G-PD-2 named-preset >100 retention remains open; does not block unrelated S06 work
G-UI-CONFORMANCE/G-EXTENSION-PANEL/G-EXTENSION-WIDGET-SCOPE verified only actual included production scope
Physical touch/CEF/nativeGPU or unsupported platform branches need actual environment evidence; synthetic events are not substitute
priorControls: S05 Human merge/start instruction supplies S06 authority; roadmap order alone would not.

separateControls.merge: NOT_GRANTED for S06 future candidates; S05 merge control is scoped
separateControls.publication: No new S06 remote publish authority inferred

workingRules.routine: Engineer/self-test/Fresh Review/ordinary repair continue under this scope without repetitive generic start or test requests.
workingRules.ownerContact: Genuine product/architecture/scope decision, indispensable Human action or direct tool permission, necessary Human experience judgement, or formal declared-scope acceptance. Present usable exact build/links before asking actual testing.
workingRules.preview: Optional continuous local preview is not a mandatory Human response gate; honest network availability.

deferredRepair: S05-FR-ESCAPE-FOCUS-001 carried to first S06 Canvas work; original technical FAIL/counters preserved, current pending source bytes known; not retroactively repaired at I6.
